biography: Mikey Doble's motorsport journey began not on a pristine track, but on the muddy fields of his family's farm in rural Lincolnshire. Tinkering with tractors morphed into a passion for speed, culminating in his first taste of competitive racing in a beat-up Ginetta G40 at a local club event. That day, finishing mid-pack but fueled by adrenaline, set the course for his life. Doble quickly rose through the Ginetta ranks, showcasing raw talent and aggressive driving. His peak came in the Ginetta GT4 Supercup, battling seasoned veterans and securing multiple podiums. However, recent seasons have been less kind. As the younger generation of drivers emerges, Doble struggles to maintain his edge, grappling with increasingly inconsistent results and a growing sense that his time at the top might be waning. He clings to the hope of rediscovering his earlier form, determined to prove he still has what it takes, even as the odds stack against him.
drivingStyle: Doble's driving style is best described as 'defensive aggression.' He is fiercely protective of his position, often making late, hard-braking maneuvers to fend off overtakes. While his tire management is adequate, his focus is primarily on immediate defense rather than long-term strategy. Under pressure, he tends to become more erratic, sometimes resulting in costly mistakes. He excels in wet conditions, where his aggressive style gives him an advantage, but struggles when the car isn't perfectly balanced.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision at Brands Hatch that cost Doble a race win. The two have exchanged heated words and on-track aggression ever since.
Doble sees Khan, a young, rising star, as a direct threat to his place in the sport. He often criticizes her driving in the media, fueling a tense rivalry.
Alvarez, known for his cool and calculated driving, consistently outmaneuvers Doble on the track, frustrating Doble's aggressive style and leading to on-track clashes.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, regardless of the weather.
Refuses to start a race without tapping the steering wheel three times.
Has a detailed notebook where he meticulously logs every lap time and car setup adjustment, a habit he's maintained since his early days in racing.
famousQuote: "They can try to push me off the track, but they'll never break my spirit. I'll fight for every inch until the checkered flag."
careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta GT4 Supercup race at Silverstone in 2018, after a thrilling last-lap overtake that cemented his reputation as a fierce competitor.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2021 Donington Park race, costing him a potential championship victory and severely denting his confidence.
